recommendations.title: Microdochium patch risk is building
recommendations.message: Modelled risk is 2/4. Conditions are turning favourable for the disease — increase monitoring frequency, especially after the next rain.

recommendations.title: Topsoil is saturated
recommendations.message: Modelled topsoil moisture is 41%. Avoid mowing, rolling or heavy foot traffic until it drains, to prevent compaction and surface damage.

recommendations.title: Soil temperature suits seeding, but moisture doesn't
recommendations.message: Soil temperature is 8.2°C (good for germination) but topsoil moisture is currently saturated — irrigate or let it drain before seeding.

recommendations.title: Too windy to spray today
recommendations.message: Wind is forecast up to 20 km/h, above the typical safe spraying range — drift risk is elevated. Wait for calmer conditions.

recommendations.title: Dew expected tomorrow morning — remove it early
recommendations.message: Forecast temperature and dew point are within 1.2°C of each other in the early hours, so a heavy dew is likely — and microdochium risk is already 2/4. Switching, brushing or an early mow to knock dew off is the single most effective cultural control while disease pressure is elevated.

recommendations.title: Keep mowers and rollers off today
recommendations.message: The surface is likely too wet for machinery (topsoil moisture is 41%). Mowing or rolling wet turf risks rutting, scalping and compaction — and wet clippings spread fungal disease. Wait for it to dry or drain.

recommendations.title: Dollar spot risk is low
recommendations.message: Modelled risk is 12%, well under the 20% threshold. Routine monitoring is enough.

recommendations.title: Water balance is in a healthy range
recommendations.message: 7-day net balance is -7mm — no irrigation action needed today.

recommendations.title: Nitrogen guidance (growth-potential scaled)
recommendations.message: Average growth potential over the last 30 days is 59%, suggesting roughly 15 kg N/ha this month (= 59% of the 25 kg/ha peak-growth ceiling). Feed only what growth can use — and if the site is in a Nitrate Vulnerable Zone, check the closed-period panel on the dashboard before applying manufactured nitrogen.

forecast.dollar_spot_status: model inactive (5-day mean temp outside 10-35C range)
